# Research report 1 of 2

I couldn't open any page directly because the proxy refused every fetch, including usopen.org, ATP, ESPN, Kalshi and Al Jazeera. Everything below comes from search-result snippets. I left out any result dated after 2026-08-26.

## 1. Resolution source
- I couldn't fetch the official source (usopen.org). On 2026-08-26 the tournament is still in its qualifying week. Reports put the main draw at Aug 30 to Sep 13, and no men's singles result exists yet. [ABC/AP](https://abcnews.com/Sports/wireStory/top-ranked-jannik-sinner-withdraws-us-open-knee-135839155)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. Alcaraz is entered and expected to be one of the top two seeds, and he has not played a main-draw match. I couldn't confirm whether the draw had been made by Aug 26. It usually comes out a few days before the main draw starts.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-23: Greg Rusedski called Alcaraz's return "a huge risk." [Punto de Break](https://www.puntodebreak.com/en/2026/08/23/rusedski-warns-about-alcarazs-return-at-the-us-open-its-huge-risk)
- 2026-08-21: World No. 1 Jannik Sinner withdrew with a right knee injury. He hasn't played since winning Wimbledon in July, he skipped Toronto and Cincinnati, and this is the first major he has missed since 2019. Draper and Rune are also out. [The Star/Reuters](https://www.thestar.com.my/sport/tennis/2026/08/21/tennis-sinner-to-miss-us-open-due-to-knee-injury), [NST](https://www.nst.com.my/amp/sports/racquet-sports/2026/08/1516303/sinner-withdraws-us-open-due-knee-injury-draper-and-rune-also)
- 2026-08-20: Alcaraz confirmed he will return at the US Open after about four months out with a right wrist injury from the Barcelona Open in April. He missed Roland Garros, Wimbledon, Toronto and Cincinnati. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/8/20/carlos-alcaraz-confirms-us-open-return-after-four-month-injury-layoff)
- About 2026-08-05: He withdrew from Cincinnati, which raised doubts about whether he would defend his title. [Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2622195/alcaraz-withdraws-from-cincinnati-event-as-doubts-grow-over-us-open-defence), [Hoodline](https://hoodline.com/2026/08/wrist-woes-carlos-alcaraz-quits-cincinnati-new-york-us-open-defense-in-doubt/)
- Undated, probably mid-to-late August: The Daily Beast reported that Alcaraz's Polymarket price dipped after a "rusty" exit from the mixed doubles. I couldn't verify the date or the details. [Daily Beast](https://www.thedailybeast.com/rusty-star-throws-us-open-mens-odds-in-flux/)
- 2026-01: He won the Australian Open, beating Djokovic in the final. That was his 7th major and completed the career Grand Slam. [ATP](https://www.atptour.com/en/news/alcaraz-australian-open-2026-big-titles)

## 4. Base rates
- Alcaraz at the US Open: champion in 2022, semifinal in 2023, second round in 2024, champion in 2025, beating Sinner in the final. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carlos_Alcaraz)
- He has won 7 of the last roughly 17 majors he played (2022 US Open through 2026 AO). Since 2024, Sinner and Alcaraz have won almost every major between them. With Sinner out, the main remaining threats are Zverev, Djokovic, Shelton and Fils.
- Against him: no men's US Open champion has defended the title since Federer in 2008. Winning a major straight after a roughly 4.5-month layoff with no warm-up matches is rare in the modern era. I didn't find a systematic statistic on this.

## 5. Other forecasts
- After Sinner withdrew (Aug 21 to 26), sportsbooks priced Alcaraz at about +170 to +240, roughly 29-37% implied. [RG.org](https://rg.org/news/tennis/us-open-mens-odds-predictions-best-bets)
- Oddstrader had Alcaraz +195, Zverev +340 and Djokovic +700. [Oddstrader](https://www.oddstrader.com/betting/mens-us-open-tennis-odds/)
- Kalshi traders priced Alcaraz at about 27-34%. [Kalshi News](https://news.kalshi.com/p/us-open-odds-alcaraz-favored-sinner-withdraws)
- Polymarket had Alcaraz at 26% and Zverev at 22%, from the Daily Beast article; the snapshot date is uncertain. [Daily Beast](https://www.thedailybeast.com/rusty-star-throws-us-open-mens-odds-in-flux/)
- Before Sinner withdrew, Sinner was about -150 and Alcaraz about +185. [Tennisnerd](https://www.tennisnerd.net/news/early-us-open-2026-preview-and-odds-favorites/68136)
- ESPN said Alcaraz is favored but noted he hasn't played since April. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/tennis/story/_/id/49744097/with-jannik-sinner-carlos-alcaraz-favored-us-open)
- I couldn't load a live Polymarket or Kalshi page dated exactly Aug 26.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The draw release, probably around Aug 27, will show his path and possible quarterfinal opponents.
- The main draw starts Aug 30. Early rounds will be the first real test of his wrist, serve speed and match fitness. Any flare-up or retirement would end his chances.
- Late withdrawals by other contenders would also matter.

Sources: the links above.

# Research report 2 of 2 (written independently)

I could not load the official U.S. Open site or the betting pages, so the information below comes from search results and was cut off at 2026-08-26. Search results also showed how the tournament played out. I have left all of that out, including the draw released 2026-08-27 and later odds.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-08-26: The official site (usopen.org) would not load ("proxy refused the connection"), so I can't report its current status. Several reports say main-draw singles runs from Aug 30 to Sep 13. Aug 23-29 was qualifying week. [Khaleej Times](https://www.khaleejtimes.com/sports/tennis/alcaraz-confirms-us-open-return-after-four-month-injury-layoff)
- As of the cutoff, the main draw had not been released and no main-draw matches had been played.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. Alcaraz is entered and expected to play. He is the defending champion (beat Sinner in the 2025 final). [ABC/AP](https://abcnews.com/Sports/wireStory/top-ranked-jannik-sinner-withdraws-us-open-knee-135839155)
- He has not played a competitive match since mid-April, so his form is unknown.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-21: World No. 1 Jannik Sinner withdrew because of his right knee. He had already skipped Toronto and Cincinnati and is aiming for Beijing and Shanghai. Draper and Rune are also out. [Reuters via The Star](https://www.thestar.com.my/sport/tennis/2026/08/21/tennis-sinner-to-miss-us-open-due-to-knee-injury), [NST](https://www.nst.com.my/amp/sports/racquet-sports/2026/08/1516303/sinner-withdraws-us-open-due-knee-injury-draper-and-rune-also)
- 2026-08-21: Sinner's last event appears to be his Wimbledon title run in July, though reports differ on when the knee injury happened. [Deccan Chronicle](https://www.deccanchronicle.com/sports/jannik-sinner-withdraws-from-us-open-2026-with-knee-injury-1981110)
- 2026-08-20: Alcaraz confirmed on social media ("Here we go") that he will play and defend his title after about four months out. [AP via NBC Sports](https://www.nbcsports.com/tennis/news/carlos-alcaraz-is-set-to-return-from-a-wrist-injury-and-defend-his-u-s-open-title), [Khaleej Times](https://www.khaleejtimes.com/sports/tennis/alcaraz-confirms-us-open-return-after-four-month-injury-layoff)
- 2026-08-05: His wrist forced him out of Cincinnati, his original target for a comeback. He also missed Toronto. [BusinessDay](https://www.businessday.co.za/sport/2026-08-05-wrist-injury-forces-alcaraz-out-of-cincinnati-ahead-of-us-open/)
- May to July 2026: He missed Roland Garros (as defending champion) and Wimbledon. [Khaleej Times](https://www.khaleejtimes.com/sports/tennis/alcaraz-confirms-us-open-return-after-four-month-injury-layoff)
- 2026-04-15: He withdrew from Barcelona with a right wrist injury ("I felt my wrist give out on a return"). Just before that he had lost the Monte Carlo final and the No. 1 ranking to Sinner. [beIN](https://www.beinsports.com/en-mena/tennis/articles-video/alcaraz-pulls-out-of-barcelona-open-with-wrist-injury-2026-04-15), [Punto de Break](https://www.puntodebreak.com/en/2026/04/15/alcaraz-explains-the-extent-of-the-injury-that-forced-him-to-withdraw-from-barcelona)
- Before the cutoff, former finalist Greg Rusedski said he doubted Alcaraz would actually play ("I don't think he will play"). This is opinion, not a report of a withdrawal, and the article's exact date is unclear. [Tennishead](https://tennishead.net/carlos-alcaraz-predicted-to-withdraw-from-the-us-open-at-the-last-minute-i-dont-think-he-will-play/)

## 4. Base rates
- Alcaraz won the U.S. Open in 2022 and 2025. That is 2 titles from 5 appearances (2021 to 2025).
- From memory rather than a source checked here: he won the 2026 Australian Open, his last Slam before the injury.
- Since 2024, Sinner and Alcaraz have shared every Slam title. With Sinner out, the main threats are Zverev, Djokovic and Americans such as Fritz and Shelton.
- Winning a Slam with no warm-up matches after more than four months away is historically rare. Federer at the 2017 Australian Open, after six months out, is the best-known exception. I found no systematic data on this.

## 5. Other forecasts
- About 2026-08-21, just after Sinner withdrew: Kalshi had Alcaraz at about 34% and Zverev about 21%. [Kalshi News](https://news.kalshi.com/p/us-open-odds-alcaraz-favored-sinner-withdraws)
- Same period, sportsbooks:
  - Yahoo reported Alcaraz shortening from +175 to +140 (about 42%), with Zverev +300 and Djokovic +750. [Yahoo Sports](https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/updated-2026-us-open-odds-155918976.html)
  - Oddstrader listed Alcaraz at +195 and Zverev at +340. [Oddstrader](https://www.oddstrader.com/betting/mens-us-open-tennis-odds/)
  - DraftKings had Alcaraz at +250. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/tennis/story/_/id/49744097/with-jannik-sinner-carlos-alcaraz-favored-us-open)
- Polymarket: I found no reliable number. One aggregator showed Alcaraz at 40.5%, but its figures looked stale and contradicted each other. [CryptoSlate](https://cryptoslate.com/predictions/market/2026-mens-us-open-winner-tennis/)
- Overall, implied odds for Alcaraz at the cutoff ranged roughly from 30% to 40%. He was the clear favorite, with Zverev second.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The main-draw release (around Aug 27), which will show his likely opponents.
- Any late withdrawal by Alcaraz if his wrist flares up (Rusedski's view).
- Main-draw play starts Aug 30. The early rounds are the first real test of his wrist and match fitness after more than four months out.
